name: Join
description: From joining a relay to opening your face: the steps a new node takes, one list.

steps.name: Join
steps.text: Join a relay with your email, or add your email to the relay you are on.

steps.name: Find someone
steps.text: Find someone on the network and add them. You can skip this.

steps.name: Configure your node's remote control
steps.text: Ask the relay for a name, your face, so you can reach this node from anywhere.

steps.name: Open your face
steps.text: Open your face in a browser, on your phone or anywhere.
